thesis: Large earnings surprises with a same-direction price reaction can continue for one to three sessions.
universe: liquid US stocks reporting in the last two sessions
trigger: Material revenue or earnings surprise plus same-direction reaction and intact guidance mechanism.
entry_rule: Enter with the reaction after verifying the release, liquidity, and no contradictory guidance detail.
exit_rule: Price invalidation, target, contradictory filing, or 72-hour time stop.
sizing_hints: Prefer liquid names; do not trade a headline without the primary release.
